question: In what form and with what purifying role is the invoked power asked to remain always?
premises: The power is addressed as destroyer of all flaws.
It is asked to remain at all times.
It is asked to stay in a form associated with the lord.
inference: The flaw-destroying power is petitioned to remain always in the lord's form.
plain_english: O destroyer of all flaws, always remain here in the form of the lord.
